name: A-TOP HEALTH BIOTECH CO LTD
summary: A-Top Health Biotech Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells medical aesthetic and reconstructive surgical materials, polymer biomaterials, and AI-driven digital solutions in Asia-Pacific markets. The company offers products, such as medical threads for minimally invasive treatments, medical-grade plant-based health supplements, and skin care medical devices; and services, including AI dynamic visualization and digital services for clinics. The company was founded in 2021 and is based in Taipei, Taiwan.
